BiblicalUsage: Samson's parents did not know that his seeking a Philistine wife was an occasion against the Philistines, for the Lord sought an occasion against them. Jeremiah uses the same word for a wild ass in her heat, snuffing up the wind in her occasion, whom none can turn back. The word is an occasion, an opportunity: a moment God uses, or a drive no one can restrain.
TheologicalSignificance: Two uses sit side by side on purpose, I believe: God can take an occasion men do not understand, and sin has its own occasion that rushes headlong and will not be turned.
